defect.summary: Synthetic invoices contain incorrect tax values
defect.reproduction_steps: Run the billing job against the supplied synthetic customer and tax-rate snapshot.
defect.observed_behavior: Invoices use tax rates from an outdated reference snapshot.
defect.expected_behavior: Invoices use the current tax-rate reference data.

current_question: What deeper cause made this possible: the tax-rate reference table was not refreshed with the current synthetic rates before the billing job ran? What evidence shows that this deeper cause is real rather than assumed?

why_chain.answer: Because the billing job applied an outdated tax-rate reference snapshot to the synthetic invoices.
